{{Current events|year=2023|month=01|day=31|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Foreign involvement in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[France|French]] [[Minister of the Armed Forces (France)|Armed Forces Minister]] [[Sébastien Lecornu]] announces that [[List of foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|France will send]] 12 additional [[CAESAR self-propelled howitzer]]s to [[Ukraine]], and could also train [[Ukrainian Air Force]] pilots to operate French fighter jets as part of their latest military support package. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/france-send-12-additional-caesar-howitzers-ukraine-2023-01-31/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tanda Dam boat disaster]]
**The death toll from a boat [[capsize]] at the [[Tanda Dam]] in [[Kohat District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], on 29 January increases to 51. [https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/31/01/2023/death-toll-from-pakistan-boat-capsize-jumps-to-51 (AFP via ''The Peninsula'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois]]
****[[Governor of Illinois|Illinois Governor]] [[J. B. Pritzker]] announces that [[Illinois|the state]] will end its [[COVID-19]] emergency proclamation after three years beginning on May 11. [https://www.sj-r.com/story/news/politics/state/2023/02/01/illinois-gov-jb-pritzker-sets-date-to-end-covid-19-health-emergency/69860171007/ (''The State Journal-Register'')]
*The [[Ministry of Environment and Tourism (Namibia)|Namibian environment ministry]] announces that 61 [[black rhinoceros]] and 26 [[white rhinoceros]] were killed in [[Namibia|the country]] in 2022 as a result of [[poaching]], including 46 in [[Etosha National Park]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/31/rhino-poaching-surges-93-percent-in-namibia (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[List of pastoral visits of Pope Francis|Pastoral visits of Pope Francis]]
**[[Pope Francis]] begins his first [[papal visit]] to the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. He will also visit [[South Sudan]] on the same trip. [https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1685959-20230131.htm (AFP via RTHK)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022–23 Salvadoran gang crackdown]]
**The Salvadoran government opens the [[Terrorism Confinement Center]], a prison with a capacity of 40,000, amidst a gang crackdown which has arrested over 62,000 people since March 2022. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/el-salvador-opens-40000-person-prison-arrests-soar-gang-crackdown-2023-02-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Killing of Tiba al-Ali]]
**A [[YouTuber]] is killed in [[Iraq]]; her father confesses to the [[honour killing]]. [http://aljazeera.com/news/2023/2/4/iraqis-outraged-after-father-kills-youtube-star-daughter (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Protests against Emmanuel Macron]]
**[[2023 French pension reform strikes]]
***A second day of [[strike action|strikes]] and [[political demonstration|demonstrations]] occurs throughout [[France]] against the [[Borne government|government]]'s pension reform project, which proposes to increase the [[retirement age]] to 64. [https://www.bfmtv.com/economie/economie-social/social/carte-greve-contre-la-reforme-des-retraites-ou-auront-lieu-les-manifestations-ce-mardi-31-janvier_AN-202301300127.html (BFMTV)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022–23 Premier League]]
**[[Chelsea F.C.]] [[List of English football transfers winter 2022–23|sign]] [[Argentina national football team|Argentinian]] [[central midfielder]] [[Enzo Fernández]] from [[Primeira Liga]] club [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]] in a £106.8m deal to break the [[Progression of the British football transfer fee record|British football transfer fee record]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2023/feb/01/chelsea-to-sign-enzo-fernandez-benfica-british-record-transfer-fee (''The Guardian'')]
